description: One AI tool from the INITE Atlas, by domain or name: what it does and who it is for, the starting price with its page, the day read and how it moved, how a program reaches it (API docs, a parsed OpenAPI document, an MCP server in the official registry and its tie to the vendor, a status page), what it states about your data (certifications, training on your data), and how used and how alive it is. Every fact is dated; 'claimed' and 'found' are kept apart. AI tools and software only, by INITE's measurement; a business's own confirmed facts are INITE Directory's (find_business, business).
name: atlas_lookup
title: One AI tool's measured record
